name: TetherGuard
subtitle: iPhone USB tethering companion
description: iPhone network and battery diagnostics, a manual internet test, and USB tethering setup guidance. The Windows helper handles USB route and traffic monitoring. Cannot force Personal Hotspot to stay on or increase cellular speed.
